source_manifest_reference: Complete bounded proposal text in the conversation

items.source_item: AUTOSAR architecture and data principles as a cross-industry reusable blueprint
items.intent: Reuse model-driven engineering, explicit interfaces and machine-readable evidence across sectors
items.rationale: The reusable capability is retained as a layer-based adapter contract. AUTOSAR-specific decomposition and deterministic scheduling are not imposed on unrelated sectors.
items.protected_outcome: Useful reuse without false standard equivalence
items.verification_reference: Layer taxonomy and controlled adapter contract
items.follow_up_trigger: A project selects a domain standard candidate

items.source_item: Exact AUTOSAR equivalents exist in every listed industry
items.intent: Provide a simple routing table for domain engineering standards
items.rationale: The listed items mix lifecycle, architecture, runtime, communication, exchange format, HMI and assurance layers. Treating them as exact equivalents can select the wrong validator and create false compliance claims.
items.verification_reference: Official issuer scopes mapped by layer

items.source_item: OPC UA, IEC 61499, PLCopen and AutomationML form the industrial AUTOSAR equivalent
items.intent: Create a structured Industrial Automation adapter
items.rationale: The standards are treated as complementary candidates with separate communication, information-model, engineering-exchange, language and runtime responsibilities.
items.protected_outcome: Correct industrial architecture and toolchain scope
items.verification_reference: Official OPC Foundation and AutomationML scopes plus adapter review
items.follow_up_trigger: An industrial project identifies its plant, controller and safety boundary

items.source_item: SDC, HL7 FHIR and DICOM are medical AUTOSAR equivalents
items.intent: Use structured medical interoperability data in governed engineering flows
items.rationale: FHIR is healthcare information exchange, DICOM is imaging-related exchange and SDC addresses connected medical-device interoperability. A future project adapter must keep these scopes separate from the medical-device software lifecycle and regulatory assurance case.
items.protected_outcome: Medical interoperability without architecture or approval overclaim
items.verification_reference: Official HL7 FHIR scope and project-specific medical applicability gate
items.follow_up_trigger: A medical-device workspace defines intended use, market and interoperability scope

items.source_item: FACE and ARINC 653 are the general aerospace AUTOSAR equivalent
items.intent: Support modular avionics architecture and partitioned execution evidence
items.rationale: FACE and ARINC 653 are mapped to their architecture, conformance and runtime-partitioning layers. Project and certification-authority scope decide applicability; they are not universal to civil aircraft or space systems.
items.protected_outcome: Correct aerospace certification and platform scope
items.verification_reference: The Open Group FACE latest-edition documentation and aerospace activation requirements
items.follow_up_trigger: A named aerospace programme and certification basis exist

items.source_item: EULYNX, OCORA and RaSTA are interchangeable rail architecture equivalents
items.intent: Use machine-readable rail signalling interfaces and models
items.rationale: EULYNX is retained as a signalling architecture and interface candidate while infrastructure-manager and national applicability remain explicit. OCORA and RaSTA require their own scope evidence. The former EULYNX DataPrep model is marked unmaintained by its issuer.
items.protected_outcome: Current and correctly scoped rail assurance
items.verification_reference: Official EULYNX scope and DataPrep maintenance notice
items.follow_up_trigger: A rail project names system boundary, infrastructure manager and national rules

items.source_item: IEC 61162-450, OpenBridge, NMEA and S-100 form a ship-control AUTOSAR equivalent
items.intent: Structure maritime communications, data and HMI evidence
items.rationale: The candidates are separated into networking, interfaces, hydrographic data products and HMI guidance. OpenBridge states that no formal approval process exists, and S-100 is not a ship-control middleware.
items.protected_outcome: Marine safety and class evidence without false platform claims
items.verification_reference: Official IHO S-100 and OpenBridge scope statements
items.follow_up_trigger: A marine project names ship type, flag, class and operational profile

items.source_item: BIM, IFC, BCF and building gateways are the construction AUTOSAR equivalent
items.intent: Use open machine-readable building information and issue exchange
items.rationale: IFC, IDS, BCF and bSDD retain distinct information and collaboration roles. BIM does not replace professional design responsibility, permits, structural checks, construction inspection or country-specific contracts.
items.verification_reference: Official buildingSMART IFC and BCF scopes
items.follow_up_trigger: A built-environment project approves its BIM uses and information requirements

items.source_item: Presidio masks private IPs, NodeIds, recipes and all domain identifiers
items.intent: Prevent sensitive industrial and domain data from leaving controlled boundaries
items.rationale: PII detection is supplemented by project IP classification, secret hard blocks and stable meaning-preserving tokenisation. Private IPs are topology information, not automatically personal data, and blanket masking can break engineering semantics.
items.protected_outcome: Confidentiality with usable, traceable engineering context
items.verification_reference: AI processing envelope and industrial information-protection rules
items.follow_up_trigger: Representative classified fixtures and an approved external route exist

items.source_item: AI-generated PLC Structured Text is safe after syntax, library validation and compilation
items.rationale: Syntax and compilation do not establish timing, I/O allocation, fail-safe behaviour, safety integrity, cybersecurity or abnormal-condition correctness. AI output is quarantined and cannot write to a controller.
items.verification_reference: Industrial AI output boundary and ten-step validation ladder
items.follow_up_trigger: A bounded candidate-generation pilot has simulation, hardware tests and independent review

items.source_item: Only the metamodel schema and Presidio regex collection change between industries
items.intent: Keep the shared gateway, RAG and inference infrastructure modular
items.rationale: The shared envelope may be reused, but each domain changes lifecycle, assurance class, authorities, semantics, parsers, validators, tool confidence, licences, human gates, operational evidence and incident handling. Schema-only substitution would create false assurance.
items.protected_outcome: Domain-correct safety, compliance and release evidence
items.verification_reference: Controlled adapter contract and project activation requirements
items.follow_up_trigger: Any new domain profile or adapter is proposed
